summary: Lemhi County, ID cabin lookout on the Salmon National Forest: 1924 staffing report, 1935 cabin, destroyed 1970; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1970; the Forest Lookouts page also gives its status as Removed, with no date
facts.location: about 40 miles northwest of Salmon, Lemhi County, Idaho

staffing.status: one person stationed, per a 1924 Salmon Forest report; no later staffing given

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site hike-in

events.note: Salmon Forest lookout report, as summarized on the Forest Lookouts page: one person stationed, with no telephone communications
Recorder Herald item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page: new lookout buildings under construction at Bluenose and Skunk creek; the item names the creek, not this lookout
Cabin, per the Forest Lookouts page (credited to Kresek), firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts
Destroyed, per the Forest Lookouts page, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts

evidence.supports: 1924 report: one person stationed, no telephone
evidence.quote: 1924: The Salmon Forest lookout report shows that one person is stationed here, and that he had no telephone communications.

evidence.supports: 1932 Recorder Herald item: two named men constructing new lookout buildings at Bluenose and Skunk creek under Forest Service supervision
evidence.quote: Perry Black and Murd McNicoll are constructing new lookout buildings at Bluenose and Skunk creek under the supervision of the forest service.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Three pages give destruction in 1970; the Forest Lookouts page also gives a status of Removed with no date. The story reports the 1970 destruction and the Removed label.
A 1932 newspaper item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page mentions new buildings at Skunk creek; the 1935 cabin date appears on three pages. The 1932 item is not confirmed as being about this lookout.

notes_for_editor: The 1924 and 1932 items reach us only as summaries and quotes on the Forest Lookouts page; the originals were not found. Elevation 7,229 ft comes from firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. A LiDAR listing (listsofjohn.com) gives 7,236 ft and was not cited. No source describes what remains at the site or whether it is open.
